_comment: Applied by the paperless-workflows-apply Job (ingestbuddy#7 / infra-ops#61 + #56). This is NOT the raw Paperless /api/workflows/ payload shape: filter_has_all_tag_names / filter_has_not_tag_names are resolved to real tag IDs by apply.py (name -> ID, after pipeline-tags.json has been upserted) before the real API call is made. The webhook header's __PAPERLESS_WEBHOOK_SECRET__ placeholder is substituted with the live INGESTBUDDY_PAPERLESS_WEBHOOK_SECRET value from this Job's environment (ExternalSecret external-paperless-workflows-credentials) -- never commit the real secret value here. This file is consumed via a kustomize configMapGenerator (see ../kustomization.yaml), so any edit here changes the generated ConfigMap's content-hash suffix, which changes the Job's pod template, which is what makes ArgoCD's Replace=true,Force=true actually recreate and re-run the Job -- editing this file is itself the 'force a rerun' mechanism, nothing else to bump.
name: pipeline:eingang intake

webhook.body: {"doc_id": {{ doc_id }}, "doc_title": "{{ doc_title }}", "doc_url": "{{ doc_url }}", "correspondent": "{{ correspondent }}", "document_type": "{{ document_type }}", "added": "{{ added }}", "owner_username": "{{ owner_username }}"}
